title: Funding and Viewership Ratings for Public Service Broadcasting Programmes
what_it_is: Funding and Viewership Ratings for Public Service Broadcasting Programmes

sections.label: Government funding for Mediacorp
sections.summary: The Government has allocated about $380 million annually to Mediacorp over the past five financial years, and Mediacorp reached over 90% of the local population.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Over the past five financial years, the Government has allocated about $380 million annually to support Mediacorp to reach domestic audiences across four languages.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: This is lower than the annual funding of approximately $750 million allocated to the national broadcasters of Finland and Denmark, which have similar population sizes to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Mediacorp reached more than 90% of the local population through its owned and operated platforms as well as social media platforms.

sections.label: Mediacorp TV and meWATCH reach
sections.summary: Mediacorp's TV reach dropped about 10% over the last decade, while unique video viewers on meWATCH rose about 80% in the same period.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: For example, Mediacorp's TV reach dropped by about 10% over the last decade or so, but unique video viewers on meWATCH have increased by about 80% in the same period.

sections.label: International Co-Production Fund support
sections.summary: The Infocomm Media Development Authority's International Co-Production Fund, launched about two years ago, funds local drama producers to collaborate with international counterparts to reach audiences beyond Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Another very important way in which we are supporting this effort is through the International Co-Production Fund that the Infocomm Media Development Authority launched about two years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: What this programme does is to provide funding support to the producers of local drama series to collaborate with their international counterparts, and their international counterparts will include scriptwriters, directors, producers.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The reason we want to do so is to enable a reach into the wider pool of talents that are available but, more importantly, to create content that has potentially an audience beyond Singapore, even though the themes are very much anchored on Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In this way, we also help the local production houses, including Mediacorp, reach an international audience and tell Singapore stories better.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And I am pleased to share with him that since this fund was launched, in fact, there have been productions that have been provided with the support, and we will assess to what extent this kind of support can be sustained as well as expanded in the future.
